description: Model routing configuration for cost-optimized LLM selection

cheapest.useCase: Simple queries, code reviews, quick fixes, documentation

standard.useCase: Most development tasks, code generation, refactoring

complex.useCase: Complex refactoring, architecture decisions, debugging difficult issues

routingRules.description: Use cheapest model capable of completing the task
routingRules.instruction: Start with gemini-flash-lite. Only upgrade if task fails or requires more capability.

routingRules.description: Upgrade model only if task complexity requires it
routingRules.instruction: Upgrade to deepseek for: complex logic, multi-file changes, test generation. Upgrade to haiku for: architecture, difficult debugging, complex refactoring.

routingRules.description: Never use models more expensive than claude-3-haiku-20240307
routingRules.instruction: Reject any request for claude-sonnet, claude-opus, gpt-4, or other premium models. Stay within haiku pricing tier.

routingRules.description: Prefer deepseek for standard development tasks
routingRules.instruction: For code generation, refactoring, and standard development work, use deepseek as the default after gemini.

routingRules.description: Use gemini-flash-lite for simple queries and reviews
routingRules.instruction: Use gemini for: answering questions, code reviews, simple fixes, documentation, explanations.
